final_candidates.decision_summary: Highest MSA mutant frequency (0.378), perfect ESM-1v plausibility, and the only positive ProteinMPNN delta (0.864). Conservative, structurally tolerated substitution in domain II.
Strong PLM plausibility and good structural compatibility, but near-zero MSA frequency (0.014) caps confidence. Retained on model agreement.
Decent PLM and structure scores, but low MSA frequency (0.085) and high local B-factor limit confidence. Kept with modest confidence given proximity to functional regions.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 ranking is stable across all applicable evidence dimensions and further calls are unlikely to alter it.

history.rationale: Conservative basic-residue substitution on a surface-exposed domain I loop; evolutionary and PLM tolerance expected to be high with minimal impact on fold or fusion machinery.
Conservative basic-preservation substitution in a surface-exposed region; retained pending structural and evolutionary evidence.

MSA shows zero R at position 38 and lowest PLM score (0.682) plus weakest structural compatibility; position is relatively conserved (entropy 0.798). Demoted strongly despite conservative Lys→Arg chemistry.
Solvent-exposed position near the domain I-II hinge region; Val is a smaller hydrophobic replacement often tolerated and may improve stability without affecting neutralization-adjacent loops.
Common lab-adaptation-type substitution (Met-to-Val) in the DI region; retained pending MSA/PLM support.

High PLM plausibility and good structural compatibility, but near-zero MSA frequency (0.014) suggests low natural tolerance. Retained at rank 2 on the strength of model agreement but confidence capped.
Conservative hydrophobic substitution in the domain II region outside the fusion loop and glycan loop, likely preserving viability while possibly improving folding robustness.
Small hydrophobic reduction; retained but flagged as weak until structure compatibility is checked.

Best across all dimensions: highest MSA mutant frequency (0.378), perfect ESM-1v plausibility, and the only positive ProteinMPNN delta (0.864 normalized). I130V is a conservative, structurally tolerated substitution in domain II.
Position adjacent to the N154 glycosylation loop but not part of the motif; a small polar-to-methyl change could tune local flexibility without disrupting glycan addition.
Potential glycosylation-adjacent site; needs functional_annotation to assess whether N-linked glycan region is affected.

PLM and structure scores are decent, but low MSA frequency (0.085) and high local B-factor (poor local reliability) limit confidence. T160 sits near the fusion-loop/important region, so kept with modest confidence.
Surface-exposed methionine in domain III; replacement with Val removes a labile oxidizable sulfur atom while preserving hydrophobic character, potentially improving particle stability.
Stem-region Met-to-Val candidate; low prior due to proximity to membrane-proximal functional elements.
Zero MSA frequency of V at 421 despite good PLM/structure scores; M421 lies in the stem/anchor region important for conformational transitions. Rejected due to lack of evolutionary support.
